paragraphs.text: Darien's Roost was a small mountain town founded in the Karplusan Mountains during the peacemaking between Kjeldor and Balduvia .

It was the first Kjeldoran outpost allowed to be constructed in an ideal trading location for both Kjeldor and Balduvia. It was named in honor of King Darien and became part of the newly founded nation of New Argive .

Over three hundred years, the small settlement of Darien's Roost had grown into a prosperous town dedicated solely to the descendants of Kjeldor. During this period, the town had undergone a name change, at some point picking up the ancient term of Epityr .
